subject: patch for the decode path: 6 more codecs (fmt/patches/0001-fmt-decoders.patch) + a vdec_ref.c bug
body: 0001 (proposal, please review/land or tell me what to change): n2vcd_proto.h codecs vp08/vp09/av01/mp2v/mp4v/h263 (CMVideoCodecType fourccs LE, dec_codecs bits 2..7, N2VCD_DEC_CODECS_ALL 0xff), client/dec/n2vcd_dec.c + daemon/dec service/adapter acceptance, ap/n2ap_vdec fourcc->IPI (VP8 5, VP9 6, MPEG4 7, H263 8, MPEG12 9, AV1 13; V4L2 fourccs VP80/VP90/AV10/MPG2/MPG4/H263), vcodecd --fake-vdec-fmt (test builds, N2IP_FAKE_VDEC_FMT, wraps fmt/n2vdec_fmt_fake on top of the HEVC model), n2vcd_dprobe: codec from .ivf fourcc/.m2v/.m4v/.h263 + IVF / MPEG ES / H.263 PSC splitters. Rehearsal: bash gpu/hwcodec/fmt/run_sim_fmt.sh -> N2TEST FMT-SIM PASS 7 streams (H.264 control + 6). Also: dec1/vdec_ref.c sends START data[0]=buffer size, data[1]=AU length (swapped vs mtk_vcodec_dec.c:2177; n2ap_vdec.c is right): AV1 fails with it (OBU parser runs into the zero tail). compare_dec.py works unchanged for IVF/ES (ffmpeg probes); MPEG-2/4/H.263 are not bit-exact by spec (IDCT tolerance) -> PSNR. stage-vcodec.sh/guest-vcodec.sh: I widened the stream-extension checks (.ivf .m2v .m4v .h263), additive.
